title: 2010 HMMT February Guts Problem 35
statement: Call an positive integer almost-square if it can be written as \(a \cdot b\), where \(a\) and \(b\) are integers and \(a \leq b \leq \frac{4}{3} a\). How many almost-square positive integers are less than or equal to 1000000 ? Your score will be equal to \(25-65 \frac{|A-C|}{\min (A, C)}\).
